THE RAJASTHAN PREVENTIVE DETENTION (REPEALING) ACT, 1996
(Act No. 6 of 1996)
[Received the assent of the Governor on the 7th day of August, 1996]
An
Act
to repeal the Rajasthan Preventive Detention Act, 1970.
Be it enacted by the Rajasthan State Legislature in the Forty-seventh Year of the
Republic of India, as follows:1. Short title and commencement.- (1) This Act may be called the Rajasthan Preventive
Detention (Repealing) Act, 1996.

e

(2) It shall come into force at once.

od

2. Repeal of Rajasthan Act No. 23 of 1970.- The Rajasthan Preventive Detention Act,

In

di

aC

1970 (Act No. 23 of 1970) is hereby repealed.
